title: AppKit override file (metadata/overrides/appkit/<Class>.yaml)
description: Facts about one AppKit class that the SDK headers do not encode: whether it is an element and how it is made, test samples for its properties, setter-only props, extra enum names, signals (target-action, notification, delegate), child slots and exposed methods. Every fact is checked against metadata/appkit/<Class>.json and its bases by tools/metadata/appkit/gen_backend.py. Names follow the AppKit naming rules: the tag is the class without `NS` in kebab-case, props/methods/signals are native names in kebab-case. Unknown keys are errors.

sample.description: A JS value: string, number, bool, list of strings (flags) or an object (struct fields)

observability.description: What the change signal announces (plans/research/REACTIVITY.md section 4): exact, or partial with the causes it misses (programmatic: native code changing the value, e.g. clamping, never sends the action or the notification)

dangerous.description: The `dangerous:` block of an override file: native member name -> annotation, or false to exempt the member from every rule.

severity.description: corrupts-tree: re-parents or removes native children behind the renderer. owned-by-backend: state the backend sets and relies on (a delegate, a target, the application). crashes: can free or double-free a native object the backend still holds. other: anything else (say why in reason).

reason.description: One or two sentences, citing the backend code that owns the state (file:line).

use_instead.description: The svelters way to get the effect (a slot, {#if}, an attribute, an event).

evidence.description: Backend source locations (path:line) that back the reason.

reachable.description: false: JS cannot reach the member today (the backend's tables do not expose it, or a runtime guard refuses it); it is marked so exposure and inference never add it. Default true.

deny.description: Manual overrides only: inferred facts (metadata/inferred/appkit) to leave out, as `<section>:<name glob>` (`props:frame*`, `bindings:*`)

text_prop.description: Prop (kebab-case native name) that Text children of the element set (`<button>Save</button>` sets `title`); the compiler and the renderer fold static and {expr} text into it

test_setup.description: Props the generated tests set right after creating this element, in order (a pop-up-button needs items before an index can be selected)

read_errors.description: Native properties whose getter raises outside a context the header names (an NSMenu delegate callback, a tracking mode): the generated readable test expects an error from these instead of a value

write.description: A read-only property written through methods: `selector` takes the value (one argument), after `clear` (no arguments) if given. itemTitles: {selector: addItemsWithTitles:, clear: removeAllItems}

count.description: An indexed setter: the list's length goes to this selector first, then `selector` (value, index) runs once per item (labels: setSegmentCount: + setLabel:forSegment:)

child.description: The element tag of the children when they are not plain views (tab-view-item, menu-item, menu); the generated slot test inserts these

declared_on.description: The class above the ingested chain that declares the slot's selectors (NSResponder.menu): the generator does not look them up in the ingested metadata, the backend checks respondsToSelector: at run time

expect.description: After the call `get` reads back `value`, and/or the call returned `returns`

bindings.description: `bind:<name>` targets in the GTK/Qt binding format (docs/notes/fork-bindings.md section 6), read by tools/metadata/common/gen_bindings.py and tools/metadata/semantics/gen_semantics.py. The name is the native prop name in kebab-case.
